name: MonarchSignInWithRookButton
title: SignInWithRookButton
summary: The "Sign in with Rook ID" button: a standard Button with the fixed Rook ID look, a mark and a loading state.
whenToUse: In any app that offers sign-in with Rook ID. Start an ASWebAuthenticationSession in the action.
whenNotToUse: For other sign-in actions use MonarchButton. Do not restyle this button; its look is fixed so people recognise it.
api: init(_ title: String? = nil, mark: Image? = nil, variant: MonarchSignInWithRookButtonVariant = .light, size: MonarchSignInWithRookButtonSize = .md, isLoading: Bool = false, loadingLabel: String? = nil, fullWidth: Bool = false, action: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void)

init(_ title: String? = nil, markURL: URL?, variant: MonarchSignInWithRookButtonVariant = .light, size: MonarchSignInWithRookButtonSize = .md, isLoading: Bool = false, loadingLabel: String? = nil, fullWidth: Bool = false, action: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void)
enum MonarchSignInWithRookButtonVariant { case light, dark, neutral, auto }
enum MonarchSignInWithRookButtonSize { case sm, md, lg }

options.name: title
options.description: The label, already localised. By default "Sign in with Rook ID".

options.name: mark
options.description: The Rook ID mark, drawn before the title. Decorative.

options.name: markURL
options.description: The address of the mark, loaded with AsyncImage.

options.name: variant
options.description: light, dark and neutral look the same on every screen; auto follows the theme.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows a progress indicator in place of the mark and blocks the action.

options.name: action
options.description: Runs when the button is activated and not loading.

states.name: resting
states.description: A pill on the surface colour with a strong border; the neutral variant is a muted fill with no border.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The muted background; the emphasis background for the neutral variant.

states.name: loading
states.description: A progress indicator replaces the mark; the colours stay at full contrast.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The disabled text colour and a subtle border, set with disabled(_:).

appearance: A capsule. The light and neutral variants take their colours from the light theme and the dark variant from the dark theme, whatever the theme of the screen; with Increase Contrast they use the high-contrast themes. The auto variant uses the theme of the screen.
platformNotes: Rook-scoped: it exists for Rook ID only. The web can render a link; on iOS it is always a button, and the sign-in runs in ASWebAuthenticationSession in the app. Monarch ships no artwork, so the mark is passed in. The web dims a disabled button with opacity; iOS uses the disabled colour roles.
accessibility: A standard button named by its title.
The mark is decorative and hidden from VoiceOver.
While loading, VoiceOver reads "Loading" as the value and the action does not run; the button stays focusable.
The touch target is at least 44 points high at every size.
The title scales with Dynamic Type and wraps rather than truncating.
edgeCases: Without a mark the button shows the title only.
A mark that fails to load from a URL leaves its space empty.
The mark is drawn as given; in the disabled state it is not dimmed.
